Ordering prospectuses
All authorised University of Auckland agents can order hard copy prospectuses and programme books online using the
BPO Intelligence online ordering system
.
Agents can place orders for marketing material for their day-to-day use. Your material request order will be reviewed by the University of Auckland International Office marketing team and your order may be adjusted based on current stock levels.
Note that material for sessions where a representative from the University of Auckland visits the agency will be delivered to the agent's office directly by the International Office.
If your agency does not have access to the BPO Intelligence online ordering system, please arrange access by emailing us at
int-marketing@auckland.ac.nz
.
